scripts.test: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names sqlite,postgres,typeorm --prefix name "pnpm run test:sqlite" "pnpm run test:postgres" "pnpm run test:typeorm"
scripts.test:sqlite: pnpm run generate:sqlite && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" vitest run index.test.ts && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" vitest run sqlite.test.ts
scripts.test:postgres: pnpm run generate:postgres && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" vitest run postgres.test.ts
scripts.test:typeorm: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" vitest run typeorm-relations.test.ts
scripts.test:mysql: pnpm run generate:mysql && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--import tsx" vitest run mysql.test.ts
scripts.generate:sqlite: rimraf typeorm/sqlite && pnpm exec auth generate --config sqlite.ts -y
scripts.generate:postgres: rimraf typeorm/postgres && pnpm exec auth generate --config postgres.ts -y
scripts.generate:mysql: rimraf typeorm/mysql && pnpm exec auth generate --config mysql.ts -y
